decision_rows: Use separate padded row and column cubes. Do not require the Appendix B.2 field width to equal `d*n_R` without an explicit padding map.
`d=54` does not divide `2^30`. A single joint cube is not a necessity.

Fix the logical-to-padded row and column injections, Boolean bit order, matrix extension, witness extension, and all zero-padding rules. Prove that padded acceptance is equivalent to logical relation acceptance.
Separate cube sizes do not by themselves define the relation on padded rows or columns.
For `b=2,k=14`, use 14 little-endian magnitude bits with one centered sign. Reject a parent outside the strict `2^14` bound.
The paper defines split properties, but not one deterministic algorithm.
Use five complete Phi81 columns. A fresh input has 257 logical fields and 13 fixed zeros. A carried input owns all 270 fields.
Nightstream needs one stable public carrier for F-prime recursion.

Use `PaperRectangularV1`: one FE SumCheck on the row cube and one NC SumCheck on the column cube. Preserve the reviewed paper signs, source order, strict range polynomial, target, and absolute gamma order.
The row and witness-column domains have different sizes.

Select how the rectangular profile binds the NC terminal opening to the committed witness: square domain, padded row identity `M_0=[I;0]` with NC on the row cube, or one typed full-ring norm-opening CE field with a complete lifecycle.

The split profile does not inherit the paper identity binding. Rust can recompute `y_zcol` from a CE witness when the optional channel is present, but no selected extended relation and reduction theorem makes that channel mandatory and ring-closed through PiRLC and PiDEC. Every norm-dependent rule remains open until one closure is proved.
State and prove the strong and weak conditions for the exact Nightstream relations, including the extended output fields, and keep `phi` equal to the commitment projection in both stages.

Nightstream changes the relations that Lemma 3 and Lemma 4 fix. Strong condition (i) must preserve the commitment projection. The weak extractor-agreement condition and the ambient relations must cover every added field. These facts do not transfer by citation.
Fix the algebraic role, domain, transcript position, dependency order, terminal use, and soundness loss for `beta_a`, `beta_r`, and `beta_m`.
These challenges are used by Nightstream but are not part of the paper PiCCS protocol.

Separate the proof-local scalar NC terminal from one authoritative `R_K` evaluation of the 512-by-270 padded carrier-identity matrix. Derive its 9-coordinate point from the NC point through a profile-owned projection. Replay every carried ring coefficient in the next NC SumCheck through a proved constant-domain lift.

The raw flat NC opening is not closed under the PiRLC ring action. The active Lean model defines the transformed full-ring carrier output and its replay lifecycle. Current Rust reuses `s_col/y_zcol` for incompatible flat, block/lane, and ring meanings. Because the value is derivable from public `x` and `p`, this replay branch is a circuit-cost choice; recompute or removal is the simpler alternative.

Fix the exact nine selected NC coordinates, their little-endian bit order, the extension values for all other coordinates, and the constant-lift table codec. Prove the two MLE equalities and degree bound.
The active Lean carrier and generic replay models do not select or prove this bridge. Different coordinate orders are different protocols.

Fix the extension polynomial or non-residue, basis order, canonical field, extension, ring, commitment, statement, and proof encodings, matrix generation, dimension limits, and framing rules.
`F_(q^2)` and a Rust type name do not determine transcript bytes or one injective public statement.
Fix the full Poseidon2 transcript state machine, encodings, tags, phase order, challenge decoding, retry rules, and failure behavior.
The paper is interactive. Current source-level transcript behavior is not a normative byte profile.
Select one bounded strong-set sampler for native and circuit use, then prove its distribution and failure rule.
Native and circuit sampling paths do not yet have one proved distribution.
Classify each `CeClaim` field. Recompute each derived field. Reject an undeclared extension field. Do not use a digest as authority.

Select the production security target and reject any shape that does not meet it.
